def main():
    n = int(input().strip())
    s = input().strip()
    prev = -1
    max_outside = 0
    inside_words = 0
    inside = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        c = s[i]
        segment_length = i - prev - 1
        if c == '_':
            if not inside:
                max_outside = max(max_outside, segment_length)
            elif segment_length > 0:
                inside_words += 1
        elif c == '(':
            inside = True
            max_outside = max(max_outside, segment_length)
        elif c == ')':
            inside = False
            if segment_length > 0:
                inside_words += 1
        if c in ('_', '(', ')'):
            prev = i
        i += 1
    max_outside = max(max_outside, len(s) - prev - 1)
    print(f"{max_outside} {inside_words}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
